dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, it's only the twentieth, and I have no money left!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪts ˈoʊnli ðə ˈtwɛntiəθ, ənd aɪ ˈhæv ˈnoʊ ˈmʌni ˈlɛft!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Again? Do you have a budget?
dialogue.reading: əˈɡɛn? duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈbʌdʒɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Not really. I just buy things when I need them.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. aɪ ˈdʒʌst ˈbaɪ ˈθɪŋz wɛn aɪ ˈniːd ðɛm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: If I were you, I'd make a budget. Write down your income and your spending every month.
dialogue.reading: ɪf aɪ wɜːr juː, aɪd ˈmeɪk ə ˈbʌdʒɪt. ˈraɪt ˈdaʊn jʊr ˈɪnkʌm ənd jʊr ˈspɛndɪŋ ˈɛvri ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But I don't have much money. My parents send me a little every month.
dialogue.reading: bʌt aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ˈmʌtʃ ˈmʌni. maɪ ˈpɛrənts ˈsɛnd miː ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɛvri ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's why you need a budget. Where does most of your money go?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈwaɪ juː ˈniːd ə ˈbʌdʒɪt. ˈwɛr dʌz ˈmoʊst əv jʊr ˈmʌni ˈɡoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Food delivery and coffee, I think.
dialogue.reading: ˈfuːd dɪˈlɪvəri ənd ˈkɔːfi, aɪ ˈθɪŋk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: If I were you, I'd cook at home more. It's much cheaper.
dialogue.reading: ɪf aɪ wɜːr juː, aɪd ˈkʊk ət ˈhoʊm ˈmɔːr. ɪts ˈmʌtʃ ˈtʃiːpər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good idea. And what should I do with my savings? I have a little in the bank.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ənd ˈwʌt ʃʊd aɪ ˈduː wɪð maɪ ˈseɪvɪŋz? aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈlɪtəl ɪn ðə ˈbæŋk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd move it to an account with a better interest rate.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈmuːv ɪt tə ən əˈkaʊnt wɪð ə ˈbɛtər ˈɪntrəst ˌreɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then your dad is very smart!
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn jʊr ˈdæd ɪz ˈvɛri ˈsmɑːrt!
